newsitem.title: UK: Slow start on UK meals/feeds market after holiday.
newsitem.headline: Slow start on UK meals/feeds market after holiday.

text.p: Trading on the UK meals and feeds market was slow to get underway on Tuesday after Monday's Bank holiday.
"People are not interested, I have heard of very few markets and no business," said a trader.
Others said buyers were being put off by the high prices and uncertainties created by the BSE scare.
High protein soymeal rose by one stg a tonne across the board following the higher close in Chicago on Monday.
